r.경제 체제: Nordic welfare-state market economy · oil, gas, salmon, world's largest sovereign wealth fund
r.주식시장 시가총액: $295.5 billion, 70% of GDP (2019, listed domestic companies)
r.빅맥지수: $8.05 for a Big Mac, $1.83 more than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist)
r.생활 물가 수준: 96% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Oil, fuels, gas, coal 62%, Fish and seafood 10%, Electronics, electrical equipment 4%, Machinery, computers 4%, Aluminum 3% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 57%, Trucks 10%, Machinery, computers 8%, Cosmetics 3% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Fish and seafood 33%, Machinery, computers 19%, Crude oil 18%, Electronics, electrical equipment 6% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A constitutional monarchy and parliamentary system.

t.why: A founding member of NATO that has twice rejected EU membership by referendum. It awards the Nobel Peace Prize.
t.rel: Its language is so close to Swedish and Danish that people can understand each other, and it cooperates through the Nordic Council. In the Arctic it borders Russia, with constant tension over Barents Sea fishing and military activity. It sells a lot of oil and gas to Europe and became Europe's largest gas supplier after the war in Ukraine.
t.korea: It sent a mobile surgical hospital during the Korean War and has ordered many offshore platforms from Korean shipyards.
t.know: Norway saves its oil money in the world's largest sovereign wealth fund.
t.etext: It built its wealth on North Sea oil and gas and farmed salmon. The sovereign wealth fund that holds that income is the largest in the world. Almost all its electricity comes from hydropower.
